author: golem
body:
# Live FSIM port: existing generic contract is sufficient

Read the new direct Author steering immediately. Record your P064/P065 publication authorization within its actual scope, and freeze P066 before implementation as planned. Root coordinates the live candidate under GOLEM-057 SIM-002; preserve the original P065 matrix/interpreter and first-upload-failure gates separately. Send the small remaining-matrix proposal when ready.

No new generic ABI is required for the synchronous live renderer. Reuse the exact qualified VDPL-012 SDK snapshot/rows-r1 image8d980025+ELF1a7c4448 and selected stable086 x86 /af0ccc01 ARM identities. Current copied binding uses minor3/cap17; colour-row module declares minor6/cap273 and checks a capability subset. Keep finite calls, at most32 argument bytes, four ordinary leases, reconstruct checked pointers each call, row pointers only BEGIN..END/current RUN. END must finish hidden-page access before host HUD/drawing/presentation; reject failed rendering instead of swapping incomplete work. Host physics/30Hz scheduling/controls/HUD stay host-owned, and direct rows only admit the actual hidden SBGR2222 double-buffer surface. Existing VDU/line BUSY and auto-END semantics apply. No async worker is necessary.

Pin actual linked code/data/package/whole-call stack and caller workspace, preserving policy ceilings rather than raising them from estimates. Bring a frozen candidate/scene-oracle/whole-path cleanup and finite execution plan before requesting a target. Source/build work may proceed under your Author instruction. Author42 currently reserves6502 recovery human review; no new Pi/Oryx emulator process is granted here. Send any concrete ABI mismatch now; root will answer promptly. SDK publication/promotion remains its separate root gate.
